## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `c9ad209e24dd7810875aff1ddfe1abaad1a5508c` · 2026-11-25T17:50Z

PR #37298, PR 2 of 2 for #37229 (the `skills/**` half). Read against GitHub and the tree, not against the report. One should-fix is open, in the changeset; the three skill hunks themselves hold.

### Checklist

- **Shape.** Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Refs #37229`, no closing keyword on any card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37298`: CLEAN, 13 items read, none flagged). Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- **Diff, read whole.** 4 files, +14 / −4 against merge base `dfdebfadd5`: `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L111, `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` L6 and L7, `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89, and the new `.changeset/37229-skills-protocol-19.md`. Four lines rewritten in place; net 0 lines in `skills/**`. No file outside the card.
- **Premise.** #37230 merged (2026-11-25T12:51Z, `5cf9941d3f`). `git grep "protocol: '\^18'" -- skills/` at this head matches nothing. The eval's prompt and expected output moved together, and its `must_contain` list names no range.
- **Declarations.** Body and changeset both read `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` through `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine`. That is right from content: skill prose and one eval fixture, nothing the runtime accepts or refuses. `patch` on `@objectstack/skills` follows. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed.
- **Gates (check-runs at this head).** 30 success, 18 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both success; `mergeable_state` read `clean`, then `unknown` after `main` moved. `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `dbc1765a24` is clean.
- **Tier.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37298`: GOVERNED, `skills/**` ×3, Tier H. `record-recognisers.mjs --template` on the four paths: the rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- **Skills value density.** Byte-equal rewrites of one digit each; no growth, no budget question.
- **Landing order.** The body says it: "This PR lands with PR 1 or right after it, and after #37230", "It stays draft until then", and the Order-risk note. The 速读's fourth line says the same. On `main` without PR 1 the taught `'^19'` is refused by the 18 runtime, so PR 2 must not land before PR 1 (#37314).

### Changeset, sentence by sentence (`.changeset/37229-skills-protocol-19.md`)

- Summary line and the first two sentences of the body: true against the diff and against PR 1.
- Last sentence, tail clause: see S1.

### Findings

- S1 (should-fix) — the changeset's last sentence ends "no conversion is registered at step 19, so the chain an author replays still ends at 18." The first half stays true (PR 1's `step19` has `conversionIds: []`). The second half is false on any tree that holds PR 1, which is the only tree this PR may land on: `CHAIN_TERMINUS_MAJOR = Math.max(PROTOCOL_MAJOR, ...MIGRATION_MAJORS)` is 19 there, and the CLI prints `Chain:  protocol 18 → 19 (this runtime implements protocol 19)` (measured on PR 1's head `e05fdf6f18` with the built CLI). The sentence ships in `@objectstack/skills`' `CHANGELOG.md`. Fix in the changeset only: drop the tail clause, or say that step 19 carries no conversion and one semantic entry (`protocol-18-range-refused`). The head has to move anyway (K, below), so this costs no extra round.
- N1 — body, Acceptance notes: "No conversion or semantic entry is registered at step 19 on `main` `dfdebfad` … so there is no step-19 text to teach yet" is true at `dfdebfad` and stale once PR 1 lands (one semantic entry). The skill teaches one procedure, so nothing in `skills/**` needs to follow. Seat-side body edit.
- N2 — `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89 now says "every scaffold and example writes … `'^19'`". On `main` the `create-objectstack` blank template keeps `'^18'` until the version pass stamps it; the two ship together at `19.0.0-next.0`, so the sentence is true where it is published. Accepted.
- N3 — the body says "lands with PR 1 or right after it". "With" must not be read as "ahead of in the same queue batch"; the approval request should say after.

### Seat-side items (no dev work)

- **Claim line.** The newest `Claim:` comment on #37229 is 7160363498. Through `readClause2Line` it reads `Clause-②: no`; through `readMetadataProtocolLine` it reads `semantic`. This body reads `no` and `none`: the `Metadata-protocol` line differs. The amendment 7161510004 is not a `Claim:` comment and carries neither line. The seat amends the claim.
- **K.** `landing-k.mjs --pr 37298`: PRBASE `875ae40f85`, K = 21 on `origin/main` `dbc1765a24`, hold at 15; shared-budget leg: this PR and `main` after PRBASE both touch the skills token ratchet. MERGE MAIN FIRST (exit 1). Do it after PR 1 is on `main`, in the same push as S1.
- **Closing keyword.** PR 1 says `Fixes #37229` and this PR says `Refs`. As written the card closes when PR 1 merges, with this half still open. Decide which PR closes the card and say so on both.

### Verdict

REWORK, one patch round: S1 in the changeset, with the owed merge of `main` after PR 1. The contract-review record on this head is PASS (`record-37298.md`); the changeset is a prose face, so that record does not judge S1. No hand-off is written until S1 is closed.

The lines left alone hold: L74 `--from 16 --to 18` is an explicit `--to` on a worked 16 → 18 walk and still replays; L91 teaches reading the floor of a range; L122 and L178 to L183 are statements about 18.x releases.
